note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English, with soldier and worker described and the alate recorded as unknown. Distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule pyriform without the rostrum, distinctly constricted behind the antennae, widest posteriorly, antennae 12-segmented with segment 2 shortest, mandibles vestigial, each with a long narrow spine-like process; worker head capsule subquadrate, antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule golden yellow, paler posteriorly; rostrum dark brown, slightly paler at the apex; antennae rusty yellow, becoming paler towards the apex; abdominal tergites fuscous brown; legs and sternites dull yellow. Head capsule with 2 pairs of long hairs on the vertex and a few hairs near the apex of the rostrum; abdominal tergites without hairs; sternites densely covered with long and short hairs. Body length 2.40–2.65 mm. Head capsule without the rostrum pyriform, the sides distinctly constricted behind the antennae, widest posteriorly; length with rostrum 1.15–1.23 mm, length without rostrum 0.75–0.80 mm, width 0.53–0.60 mm; in lateral view concave at the base of the rostrum and at the constriction, with a slight elevation between. Rostrum short and cylindrical, about half the length of the head without rostrum, 0.37–0.43 mm long, rostrum/head length ratio 0.47–0.57; in lateral view raised anteriorly. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 2 times as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3, segments 4–8 subequal and shorter than segment 3; the remaining segments slightly shorter than the preceding one. Mandibles vestigial, each with a long, narrow, acute spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, without long hairs; anterior margin semicircular and without a notch; posterior margin slightly convex and without a notch; 0.13–0.15 mm long, 0.30–0.35 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule brown; antennae, postclypeus and thorax pale yellowish brown; abdomen fuscous brown. Head moderately pilose, body densely pilose. Body length 3.0–3.4 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, widest near the base of the mandibles; length of head to the base of the mandibles 0.88–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.93–0.98 mm; coronal suture distinct. Fontanelle plate small, nearly white. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 as long as segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus raised, almost half as long as wide. Pronotum as in the soldier, 0.25–0.33 mm long, 0.43–0.45 mm wide.
